published.archival_prose: 该房屋位于武定西路，江苏路转弯处。坐北朝南。南为主楼，北为附楼。南北楼之间设有内天井，钢筋混凝土楼梯及扶手，铁栏杆。主楼总高度11.8m（檐口处至室外地坪）。主楼南立面长21.9M，西立面长28.1m。附楼西立面长9.6m，北立面长6.4m。东外墙门廊东西向长3.4m，南北向长5.3m。房屋结构体系为砖混结构。豪式人字方木屋架，纵横墙承重体系。人字屋架搁置在南北纵墙上，主楼为平瓦四坡屋面，附楼二落水，下有吊平顶（隔热层）。屋面上有砖砌烟囱。

reading: The small Antigng garden view was EXIF-rotated before sampling. Image x increases right. Corners partly hidden by planting were bounded as intervals. The two primary axes, projected onto the facade line without lens calibration, are approximate; differences of a few decimetres remain plausible.
The reference eave is the roof eave above the recessed attic, not the lower entablature. The partial hip planes stop inside the front edge before the unseen centre or either chimney.
The three vertical planes of each end bay and the central door setback are supported by the 2008 oblique view. The east side portico visible behind the street corner belongs to the retained portion.

The centre photograph clearly shows five curved steps and the upper landing lip. Six modeled rising surfaces include the landing. The paired pale sculptural stones are represented by their general outlines.

final_proportions.basis: 2013 photo 17: column axes x236 and 310, central portico edges near x195 and 359. Photo 10: axes x223 and 292, outer envelope x100 to 455, central opening edges x185 and 338. Scale by the published 21.9m after aligning the cornice and plinth. Perspective and vegetation limit accuracy.

photo_surveys.interpretation: The near-oblique small frame gives raw projected intervals of about 4.4–5.4 m and 10.5–12.1 m; the left corner is obscured. The final intervals use the two larger independent 2013 views with corresponding upper and lower cornice points.

photo_surveys.cross_check: The camera is closer to the right end. Two front columns support the lower cornice; three open balcony spans are visible.

photo_surveys.scope: Six curved edges, including the upper landing. Lower front reaches about 1.7 times the projected column spacing. Depth is estimated, not derived from the pixel height of the treads.

photo_surveys.evidence: Independent east oblique confirms the faceted side bay, repeated rustication, true cant/return and separate upper roof. The 2008 photograph has two chimneys well behind the front strip.
